title: The Return (hero introduction)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: Epic modern South Indian cinematic hero-introduction score, instrumental. A hero returns to his city after many years. Lead instrument: nadaswaram, with solo cello and bansuri. Mode: fierce heroic minor with a raised fourth, in the mood of Carnatic Raga Shanmukhapriya; one 4-note heroic motif that keeps returning. 0-12 s: low wind-like drone and deep sub pad, one distant slow nadaswaram phrase of the motif. 12-30 s: slow heartbeat kick at 70 BPM and a low string ostinato in steady walking steps, cello states the motif quietly. 30-45 s: thavil and frame-drum rolls build, brass swells, a rising riser, the motif climbs higher each time. 45-47 s: near-silence, only a held drone. 47-70 s: massive drop with thundering drums, brass stabs and distorted electric guitar, the nadaswaram plays the full heroic theme over a driving Tamil folk dance groove at 140 BPM. 70-80 s: the motif once more on solo bansuri over a held chord, ending on a long held note. Wide cinematic stereo, deep sub-bass, punchy drums, analogue warmth. Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no chanting, no spoken words.

brief.raga: Shanmukhapriya (Carnatic melakarta 56): fierce and heroic, minor colour with a raised 4th (prati madhyamam). The hero motif is 4 notes: Sa, Ri, Ga (minor), then a leap to the raised Ma, held.
brief.tempo: 70 BPM in half-time for the walk, felt as 140 BPM after the drop
brief.lead: nadaswaram (the hero's voice), with solo cello and bansuri for memory

story: A hero walks back into his city after many years away. The city half-remembers him; then the whole street knows he is back.
